title: Our Street
text:
My street is short. There is a school at the end of it. Every morning, children walk to school with their parents. Our house is next to a small shop.

The shop sells bread and milk. The owner is a kind woman named Ayşe. She always says hello to us. I like my neighborhood because it is safe and friendly.

questions.text: What is at the end of the street?
How does the writer feel about the neighborhood?
options: They feel happy and safe there
They are afraid of the shop
They do not know the owner

questions.text: Why do the children probably walk to school with their parents?
options: The street is safe and the school is close
The school is far away in another city
Their parents work at the school
They do not like going to school

vocabulary.definition: a road in a town or village with houses or shops along it
a small place where people buy things
kind and pleasant to other people

paragraph_translations: Benim sokağım kısa. Sokağın sonunda bir okul var. Her sabah çocuklar ebeveynleriyle birlikte okula yürür. Evimiz küçük bir dükkanın yanında.
Dükkan ekmek ve süt satar. Sahibi nazik bir kadındır; adı Ayşe'dir. Her zaman bize merhaba der. Mahallemi seviyorum, çünkü burası güvenli ve samimi.
